question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

__Since __he is strong, he is quite timid.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Although**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**Although**' should be used.
 
• We use **although** to introduce a subordinate clause that contains a statement that makes the main clause of the sentence seem surprising or unexpected.
 
• It means 'in spite of the fact that'. (यद्यपि, हालाँकि)
 
 
• *Example: **Although** she was tired, she stayed up late watching television.*
 
 
 
• Thus, as per the above description, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Although** he is strong, he is quite timid.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Because**: for the reason that. (क्‍योंकि)
 
• **Besides**: in addition to or as well as somebody/something; also. (के अतिरिक्त, के साथ; भी)
